release_qualification.review_record: Three complete 27-case campaigns were collected against the exact installable skill tree cf437abcf818496c8a335a0515d2bed7395469738723b008f0f07159f2cdcfbd on two agent hosts, with two replications on the Codex Luna host. Every campaign retains a collection.json, exact parsed agent command, checked authority roots, empty collision set, and collection-time skill and case hashes. Receipt originality is UNVERIFIED throughout this bundle: it was collected before the create-once receipt guard, when a single-case repair rewrote the campaign receipt in place, and responses.jsonl carries no per-response timestamps that could substantiate the recorded collection window from inside the bundle. The luna-medium-r2 receipt is known to have been restamped this way: it records a collection start of 2026-08-04T13:40:41Z, while 26 of its 27 responses were written earlier, the last of those at 13:40:40Z, and only the repaired case follows at 13:41:02Z. That was checked against the collector output kept outside version control in the maintainer's workspace. This bundle does not retain that output and carries no response timestamps of its own, so a clean clone cannot reproduce the check. Case-local recorded results are 27/27, 25/27, and 23/27. The v0.6.4 tag was published with this bundle attached and with independent third-party review explicitly unmet; its collection-provenance condition was later found unverified because the retained receipts cannot demonstrate their association with the responses. Those deviations are recorded here and in the README rather than being reconciled after the fact.
blocking_findings: Sonnet medium r1 failed 0 of 27 cases.
Luna medium r1 failed 2 of 27 cases: citation_metadata_vs_support and html_audit_map_artifacts.
Luna medium r2 failed 4 of 27 cases: optimization_claim_scope, citation_metadata_vs_support, unmatched_baseline_comparison, and ieee_reference_format_audit.

Five of the six failures are one behaviour class: the external Author queries handoff is missing or not in the contract form, while the manuscript prose kept its scope in every case. The sixth, ieee_reference_format_audit on luna medium r2, printed six author names before et al. instead of truncating to the first author.
No failure involves invented support, concealed disclosure, a lost comparator or scope condition, a copied author fingerprint, or an unsupported guarantee.
No independent third-party review of the 450 retained criterion decisions has been completed; the review recorded here is a maintainer review.

Receipt originality is unverified for every campaign here. Collection predates the create-once receipt guard, and the retained responses carry no timestamps, so no campaign can show from inside this bundle that its collection.json is the record its own responses were collected under. The collection_record_retained flag above states only that a receipt is retained, not that it is the original.
